name: Network, DNS, TLS & Infrastructure Security
description: Network, DNS, TLS & Infrastructure Security standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-NET applies.

rules.title: Use TLS for network traffic carrying credentials or sensitive/business data
rules.detail: Use supported protocol/cipher configurations and automated certificate renewal/expiry monitoring.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use TLS for network traffic carrying credentials or sensitive/business data.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use TLS for network traffic carrying credentials or sensitive/business data.

rules.title: Apply deny-by-default network exposure
rules.detail: Expose only required ports/services and restrict administrative/data-plane access to approved sources or private networks.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Apply deny-by-default network exposure.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Apply deny-by-default network exposure.

rules.title: Separate public ingress from internal service access
rules.detail: Use controlled gateways/load balancers/private networking and avoid making databases/caches directly public.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate public ingress from internal service access.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate public ingress from internal service access.

rules.title: Manage DNS as controlled infrastructure
rules.detail: DNS changes are versioned/reviewed where feasible, use appropriate TTLs for migration, and critical records are monitored.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Manage DNS as controlled infrastructure.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Manage DNS as controlled infrastructure.

rules.title: Protect administrative access
rules.detail: Use strong identity/MFA, least privilege, audited access and avoid shared static credentials for infrastructure consoles/SSH.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Protect administrative access.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Protect administrative access.

rules.title: Document egress dependencies and firewall requirements
rules.detail: Critical third-party endpoints, ports and DNS behavior are known so network restrictions and incident diagnosis are possible.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document egress dependencies and firewall requirements.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document egress dependencies and firewall requirements.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-NET applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Network, DNS, TLS & Infrastructure Security to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Network, DNS, TLS & Infrastructure Security is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Network, DNS, TLS & Infrastructure Security failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
